about: Second read of the recent shelf, Nov 12 2026. Wording fixes only: present-tense claims that would go stale are put in the past with a year, and a few loose details are tightened. 'why' says what was wrong.

edits.old: Thirteen-year-old Mei poofs into a giant panda of a certain color whenever she gets excited in this 2022 Pixar film
edits.new: Thirteen-year-old Mei poofs into a huge, fluffy panda of a certain color whenever she gets excited in this 2022 Pixar film
edits.why: A giant panda is a different animal from a red panda.

edits.old: Sam Altman runs this San Francisco company whose chatbot kicked off the AI boom
edits.new: Sam Altman co-founded this San Francisco company whose chatbot kicked off the AI boom in 2022

edits.old: This South African-born billionaire runs both Tesla and SpaceX
edits.new: Born in South Africa, he founded SpaceX in 2002 and became Tesla's chief executive in 2008

edits.old: Since 2022 William and Catherine have been the Prince and Princess of this
edits.new: In 2022 William and Catherine became the Prince and Princess of this

edits.old: This rapper and mogul has been her husband since 2008
edits.new: She married this rapper and mogul in 2008

edits.old: Re-elected in 2022, he has been France's president since 2017
edits.new: First elected in 2017 at age 39, he won a second term as France's president in 2022
edits.why: Present tense goes stale; his term ends in 2027.

edits.old: India's prime minister since 2014, he won a third term in 2024
edits.new: He became India's prime minister in 2014 and won a third straight term in 2024

edits.old: ByteDance is the Chinese parent of this short-video app that boomed during the 2020 lockdowns
edits.new: China's ByteDance built this short-video app that boomed during the 2020 lockdowns
edits.why: Ownership is changing; who built it will not.

edits.old: iRobot makes this disc-shaped robot vacuum
edits.new: iRobot introduced this disc-shaped robot vacuum in 2002

edits.old: Elton John returned to the top ten in 2021 with 'Cold Heart', a duet with this 'Levitating' singer
edits.new: Elton John scored his biggest hit in decades with 2021's 'Cold Heart', a duet with this 'Levitating' singer
edits.why: The top-ten date was true in Britain but 2022 in America.

edits.old: Epic Universe, which opened in Orlando in May 2025, belongs to this movie studio's resort
edits.new: This movie studio's Orlando resort opened a whole new theme park, home to a land of classic monsters, in May 2025
edits.why: The park's name gave the answer away.

edits.old: In 2022 searchers found this ship of Ernest Shackleton's, crushed by Antarctic ice in 1915, two miles under the Weddell Sea
edits.new: In 2022 searchers found this ship of Ernest Shackleton's, crushed by Antarctic ice in 1915, nearly two miles down in the Weddell Sea
edits.why: The wreck lies at 3,008 meters, a little under two miles.

edits.old: In December 2020 Margaret Keenan, 90, of England became the first person outside a trial to receive one of these
edits.new: In December 2020 in Coventry, England, 90-year-old Margaret Keenan became the first person outside a trial to receive one of these
edits.why: She is from Northern Ireland; the jab was given in Coventry.

edits.old: When Finland joined NATO in 2023, the alliance's land border with this country more than doubled
edits.new: When Finland joined NATO in 2023, the alliance's land border with this country roughly doubled
edits.why: Roughly doubled is the safer wording.
